title: Semver guidelines and profile-stamp for model variants
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Introduce semantic versioning guidelines for model variants and an immutable profile-stamp attached to variant metadata. Adds DB migration, API fields, CLI utilities, docs and tests. No runtime breaking changes; rollout gated via feature flag.
commits: spec: add semver rules and profile-stamp RFC
feat: store variant.semver and variant.profile_stamp in registry
migrations: add variant_semver and profile_stamp columns + backfill
cli: model-registry stamp/generate and stamp/validate commands
docs: semver guide, churn examples and upgrade notes
test: add unit and integration tests for stamping and backfill
description: Context: we need a stable, machine-readable way to express non-breaking and breaking changes to model variants (performance profile deltas, tokenizer changes, major architecture changes) so consumers and automated release tooling can make safe rollouts and generate accurate changelogs. This PR introduces two related pieces: 1) a lightweight semantic versioning policy for model variants (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) with concrete rules for when to bump each part; 2) an immutable profile-stamp concept (profile_id + profile_checksum + semver) stored on each variant that ties a specific performance profile snapshot to a variant. Motivation: current onboarding churn makes it hard to determine whether a variant update is backwards compatible for embedding/serving contracts or is purely a profile calibration. The semver + stamp allow automated changelog generation, safer routing fallbacks, and deterministic comparisons during canaries. What this PR does: - Adds variant.semver (string) and variant.profile_stamp (string) to the registry API and DB schema, with a migration and backfill that tries to infer a sensible PATCH bump for historical variants. - Implements stamp generation code that computes a canonical profile checksum from the eval profile JSON and combines it with the semver into a single stamp like "v1.2.3+ps.9f2a1b". - Exposes CLI helpers: `model-registry stamp generate <variant>` and `model-registry stamp validate <variant>` to help validators and onboarding scripts. - Adds docs (docs/model-semver.md) with explicit rules and examples and a migration guide for operators. - Adds integration tests for stamp generation, validation, and registry lookup semantics. - Adds a small compatibility shim in the serving routing layer to prefer exact profile_stamp matches for pinned deployments and fall back by semver rules otherwise. Checklist: [x] RFC/spec in code comments and docs [x] DB migration script + safe backfill strategy [x] API + proto changes and backward compatibility notes [x] CLI tooling [x] Unit + integration tests [x] Docs and migration guide [x] Feature-flag gated rollout (default disabled for Private installs) Commits summary: see commits list above. Files changed: high-level files enumerated above; migrations/20260115_add_variant_semver.sql contains the backfill logic (non-destructive: adds columns nullable then populates). Backfill approach: infer semver from existing release notes and timestamps where possible; when ambiguous default to 0.0.PATCH with a generated stamp to avoid false major/minor bumps. Review thread summary: - Marek: asked for explicit rules for what triggers MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH and requested unit tests that simulate tokenizer changes vs profile-only changes. - Aisha: added a deterministic tokenizer-change detector heuristics and tests in test/integration/stamp_backfill_test.go; clarified MAJOR rule in docs with examples. - Kimberly: flagged that the proto change could break older SDKs; requested compatibility note and version negotiation. - Aisha: added compatibility shim and updated api migration notes; SDK teams will be notified separately for a minor SDK bump. - Luis: requested the backfill be reversible; added migration that keeps an audit table with prior values to support rollback for Private installs. CI: initial run showed a docs lint failure and an intermittent integration timeout; fixed both by reformatting docs and adding retry logic to the backfill test. Final CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint). Merge notes: squashed and merged to main on 2026-01-22 via squash merge; release will be gated behind the feature flag and accompany a model-registry minor release. Impact and follow-ups: - RK: release notes generator now consumes profile_stamp to produce per-variant changelogs. - SDK teams: coordinate minor version bump to surface semver fields. - Ops: run backfill in staging and approve before enabling feature flag in production. Related work: ENG-7923 (onboard automation), ENG-7987 (changelog tooling), PM-451 (product requirements).
